①.The Godfall Revelation includes two modes: <color=#0E70BD>Story Mode "Path of Revelation" and Match Mode "Desperado Clash"</color>;"Path of Revelation" allows you to experience the full story,"Desperado Clash" requires players to compete against each other.
①.Choose a character to explore their story and <color=#0E70BD>advance their unique path</color>
①.In Path of Revelation, you can <color=#0E70BD>uncover clues through various events</color> to progress the story
①.With enough clues collected, you can <color=#0E70BD>initiate the simulation</color>
①.<color=#0E70BD>Select the correct clues</color> based on the questions and advance the story simulation step by step
①.Tap here to select characters for this challenge

②.In Desperado Clash, each character has their own points calculated;By defeating enemies in Desperado Clash, you can earn points to <color=#0E70BD>increase your rank</color> and obtain <color=#0E70BD>Honor Rewards</color>
③.You may freely use the story-themed Coatings during gameplay

①.In Desperado Clash, you must engage in consecutive battles. Winning a battle grants 1 badge, and <color=#0E70BD>the challenge is completed</color> once you collect <color=#0E70BD>10 badges</color>;Every loss deducts 1 HP. When <color=#0E70BD>HP reaches 0, the challenge ends early</color> to tally your points and rewards earned
②.Here on the right side are the skill slots. Equip selected skills to use them in battle

③.<color=#0E70BD>Before each battle</color>, characters may enter Mysterious Tavern to <color=#0E70BD>restock supplies</color>;On <color=#0E70BD>Rounds 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9</color>, you can <color=#0E70BD>claim one free skill</color> for your inventory

①.In Mysterious Tavern, you can <color=#0E70BD>spend gold to purchase Runes</color>;Runes enhance a character's <color=#0E70BD>base stats</color> and grant them <color=#0E70BD>special abilities</color>;As the battles progress, the quantity and rarity of Runes available in Mysterious Tavern will gradually improve
②.The Rune slots are located in the center. Equip purchased Runes here to activate their effects in battle
③. You can <color=#0E70BD>spend gold</color> to unlock additional Rune <color=#0E70BD>slots</color>. The cost decreases each round, down to 1 gold
④.Refresh instantly restocks the tavern's items;Freeze prevents selected items from being refreshed

①.Skills and Runes are labeled with <color=#0E70BD>tags</color> for clarity, which includes 5 <color=#0E70BD>attribute tags</color> and 7 <color=#0E70BD>archetype tags</color>;Runes bearing <color=#0E70BD>attribute</color> tags can boost their respective attributes when certain battle conditions are fulfilled

①.In The Godfall Revelation, there are 7 <color=#0E70BD>major archetypes</color> of Runes, along with a small number of Runes without a defined archetype. Runes with the same <color=#0E70BD>archetype tag</color> share similar <color=#0E70BD>combat styles</color>
①.In The Godfall Revelation, characters engage in fully automated one-on-one battles using their equipped skills and Runes,The side whose HP drops to zero first loses the battle
②.Once the battle reaches <color=#0E70BD>30 seconds</color>, it enters the <color=#0E70BD>Death Speed</color> phase, where both sides continuously lose HP until one falls
③. During combat, both sides' <color=#0E70BD>skill</color> activation status is displayed on the edges of the screen, while the <color=#0E70BD>Rune</color> trigger status is shown at the bottom

②. Unlock <color=#0E70BD>accessories</color> at specific levels to enhance combat power or economic profits.
